notes.title: THE BIG ADVENTURE EVENT
notes.notes:
The Big Adventure Event is coming back for its second year on Steam from January 20th to 24th!
And this year, The Almost Gone will join the adventure!

The Big Adventure Event is dedicated to celebrating independant games. You can find an event hub on your steam app! Explore it, find new demos, see live streams of the different games included in it and ask questions to the developers. You can even win keys to the games!

For us, this event will be the occasion to show you more about our adventure puzzlegame The Almost Gone: trapped between life and death, frightened and alone, you must unravel the dark and poignant truth that led to your fate. From your own home to eerily deserted streets, from apartment blocks to sinister abandoned hospitals, you must search forensically for clues in beautiful dioramas.

You'll be able to see an interview from the developers of the game and better understand what The Almost Gone is all about! You can already try the game for yourself with our demo available on Steam! and don't hesitate to join the discord made for the event and ask us your questions!

Let's celebrate independant games together!

notes.title: The best game you missed in June 2020: The Almost Gone
notes.notes:
As 2020 goes kicking and screaming into that good night, we’ve rounded up some of the best games from the year that we didn’t end up covering. Check the Best Game You Missed tag for more.

For the first few months during lockdown, I spent some of my time at home working on a model greenhouse. I used white glue to attach small pieces of wood to other small pieces of wood, making door handles and boxes of pot plants and watering cans. There was an undeniable feeling of safety in the sway of a life in miniature. That is, up until I got overwhelmed by the prospect of finishing a project and let the pieces while away unglued on my bookshelf.

Perhaps I’ll get back to it at some point. In the meantime, the charming little diorama homes in The Almost Gone are here to give me my tiny-house fix.

(more…)

notes.title: Map Update now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Feeling lost in the dark mysteries of [i]The Almost Gone[/i]? The [b]Map Update[/b] will help shed some light on the poignant truths hidden in the beautiful dioramas.

In addition to bug fixes, we have added some [b]quality-of-life settings and adjustments[/b] to improve your experience with the game. This includes:

[list][*] [b]A map of each area is now available[/b] [i]-a minimap has been added to the UI that doubles as a button to open the map[/i]
[*] [b]Scale up the in-game UI text[/b] [i]-so you can go easy on your eyes![/i]
[*] [b]Choose between swipe and button controls[/b][i] -play as you like![/i][/list]

[b]Dive back into the mysterious sceneries of your empty home, eerily deserted streets and abandoned buildings with the Map Update of [i]The Almost Gone[/i][/b]

notes.title: The Almost Gone - Steam Games Festival Stream - Indie Pitch
notes.notes:
[b]Let David Prinsmel (Art Director) and Joost Vandecasteele (Writer) guide you through the story of how The Almost Gone got created![/b]

In The Almost Gone, you are poised between life and death, isolated and alone, you must unravel the poignant truths that led to your fate. Dig beneath the beautifully rendered façades and interiors of an ordinary suburban lifestyle to discover a contemporary tale crafted by an award-winning author.

Piece together this compelling story by revealing objects and memories, and decipher these clues to reveal more of the story and its secrets. From your own home to eerily deserted streets, beautiful apartment blocks to abandoned hospitals, you must search forensically for clues and the path forwards. Each new revelation takes you that one step closer to understanding, and to the people and places that surrounded you, in your all too short life.

Why are you here? Why are you trapped? Will you ever get home?

[b]DON'T FORGET TO SET A REMINDER AND JOIN US TO KNOW MORE ABOUT THE ALMOST GONE[/b]

notes.title: The Almost Gone will release on June 25th!
notes.notes:
The beautiful dioramas of [i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be yours to explore on [b]June 25th[/b]!

[previewyoutube=M2TwGoTKR-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Piece together the story and discover the events that led to your tragic death, as you progress through the empty scenes of your life.

[i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be available at $14.99, with a special [b]20% off launch price[/b] on its first week of release.

notes.title: The 10 most exciting indie games from Rezzed Digital 2020
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed, we’ve been throwing a Rezzed Digital party over the last few days, and were inundated with demo and preview builds for a whole plethora of interesting indie games. We weren’t able to play them all – but we played a lot. As is our way, a few of us got together to share our pick of the bunch, which coincidentally turned out to be a nice round 10! We weren’t even trying to do that.

notes.title: The Almost Gone set for 2020 Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to confirm that [i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be released this year on PC, Nintendo Switch and Mobile! We are still working on the game to provide the [b]best user experience possible[/b], and will soon run tests on hundreds of devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545120/78211756d79a45919c263c3084601cbc10eabf9e.gif[/img]

[i]The Almost Gone[/i] is not only a fancy looking dioramas puzzle game, but it also features an emotional and mature story that we hope will [b]make you shiver[/b].

Feel free to ask any questions about this game in this thread or on our Discord channel: [url=discord.gg/playdigious]discord.gg/playdigious[/url]

Don’t hesitate to follow [url=https://twitter.com/hvgames]@hvgames[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]@Playdigious[/url] on Twitter for upcoming news about [i]The Almost Gone[/i]!

Cheers!

Happy Volcano & Playdigious
